text: またの　なを　エスパー　ようせい　じょ　おまえ…　…　ナツメに　あおうと　してるな？

structure.jp: またの　なを　エスパー　ようせい　じょ
structure.en: also known as the Psychic Training School

structure.jp: ナツメに　あおうと　してるな？
structure.en: you're trying to meet Sabrina, aren't you?

patterns.name: 〜ようとする
patterns.explanation: The 'let's' form of a verb plus と する means trying to do it or being about to do it. あおうと してる = 'you're trying to meet'.

patterns.name: 〜ている
patterns.explanation: ている after a verb says it is going on right now. してる is the short spoken form of している. あおうと してる = 'you are trying to meet'.

patterns.name: 〜な
patterns.explanation: な at the end checks something the speaker is already fairly sure of, in a rough way. してるな？ = 'you're doing that, aren't you?'.
